manual_excerpt: Localization com.unity.localization Description Use the Localization package to easily configure localization settings for your application. Add support for multiple languages and regional variants, including: • String localization: Set different strings to display based on locale. Use the Smart Strings feature to add logic to automatically replace specific strings, such as placeholders and plurals. • Asset localization: Use a different asset (such as a texture, model, or audio file) based on a locale. • Pseudo-localization: Test how your project will adapt to different localizations at an early stage, before adding your translations. • Import and export localization data to XLIFF, CSV and Google Sheets. Add localization to your projects using the Localization package to help make your applications more accessible to a wider audience.
